config.population_ref: NDJSON records; unique population_record_id plus literal_symbol; preserve all original record fields and input order
config.grid_ref: JSON object all: ordered unique ISO civil dates, plus preserved warmup/study/note metadata
config.inputs: 0..64 exact RAW-compatible envelopes or raw-SIP source collections; links_ref nullable
config.link_semantics: source_symbol must equal the selected record's literal_symbol; request nullable means unbound legacy profile; never infer or merge an economic ID

collection.source_reference: bars/<literalAlias>; legacy bars.<literalAlias> is independently recognized literally, never split on punctuation

output.terminal_marker: content-manifest.json written last; missing marker is incomplete
output.revision: hyp003availability- plus digest of canonical manifest excluding revision
output.identity: all population/grid/source/member/code hashes; input directories are not semantic IDs
output.objects: relative path to exact bytes and sha256; manifest excludes its own object reference
output.availability_order: population input order, then supplied grid array order
output.state_scope: available supplied source evidence, never prices/zero fill, tradeable availability, venue coverage, economic admission or fitness
output.profile_state: individual received/empty/partial/unknown/failed/unrequested source status, outside request interval or unknown profile interval; preserve each revision/profile separately
output.raw_values: not copied into availability cells; exact-value hashes, existing quality results and source member/row/body/array/ordinal references are retained
output.unknown_clocks: remain null; any supplied clocks remain source-declared, not upgraded
